source: Success reports are now versioned/schema'd, while CLI errors still emit an unversioned {ok:false,error} object.
objective: Version the machine-readable CLI error envelope as nlab.live-preflight-error V1, add a Draft 2020-12 schema and test emitted error JSON without changing preflight decision behavior or exit codes.
